question: How many students live in each city?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "students" AS SELECT "stuid" AS "stuid", "ln" AS "ln", "fn" AS "fn", "age" AS "age", "sx" AS "sx", "major" AS "major", "advisor" AS "advisor", "city_code" AS "city_code" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cities" AS SELECT "cid" AS "cid", "city_name" AS "city_name", "st" AS "st", "country" AS "country", "latitude" AS "latitude", "lng" AS "lng" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT c.city_name AS city, c.country, COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM students s
JOIN cities c ON s.city_code = c.cid
GROUP BY c.city_name, c.country
ORDER BY student_count DESC, c.city_name
S:
# Aggregate number of students per city name by joining students to cities on code
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT c.city_name AS city, c.country, COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM students s
JOIN cities c ON s.city_code = c.cid
GROUP BY c.city_name, c.country
ORDER BY student_count DESC, c.city_name
"""
